issues.display_title: Issue #2088: feat(payment): flag send_invoice subscriptions as past due while the latest invoice is open
issues.main_description_html:
Problem Description

For subscriptions with collection_method = send_invoice, Stripe only moves the subscription to past_due after the invoice due date (period start + days_until_due, 30 days on this account). Until then, GET /v2/payment/subscription/status (app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/GetSubStatus.php) returns is_past_due = false, so a user who hasn't paid the renewal invoice keeps paid features for up to 30 days.

For charge_automatically, the subscription becomes past_due as soon as the first charge fails (about 1 hour after renewal).

Expected

For send_invoice subscriptions, return is_past_due = true as soon as the subscription's latest invoice is open (finalized and unpaid), without waiting for Stripe's due date.

Related: #2087 (same endpoint, cus_ profiles).

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: collection_method = send_invoice and latest_invoice.status = open → is_past_due = true, with amount_due and currency taken from that invoice.
  • AC-002: Only the latest invoice is checked. Older open invoices don't change the flag.
  • AC-003: When the latest invoice is not open (paid, void, draft), is_past_due follows the Stripe subscription status as it does today.
  • AC-004: charge_automatically subscriptions behave the same as today.
  • AC-005: The status field still returns the Stripe subscription status.
  • AC-006: Unit tests cover send_invoice with an open latest invoice, send_invoice with a paid latest invoice, and charge_automatically.

Result

Shipped in PR #2101 (Gitea) (merged into staging 2026-10-29, d52869adb). All acceptance criteria AC-001 – AC-006 passed.

  • GetSubStatus::applyStripeSubscription(): for send_invoice subscriptions, an open latest invoice sets is_past_due = true, with amount_due and currency from that invoice. Only the latest invoice is checked. status still returns the Stripe subscription status, and charge_automatically is unchanged. Both sub_… and cus_… profiles go through this path.
  • Unit tests (tests/Actions/Payment/GetSubStatusTest.php): send_invoice with an open latest invoice, send_invoice with a paid latest invoice, and charge_automatically with an open latest invoice, plus the 6 existing tests. All 9 pass.
  • E2E on the local API + local DB with Stripe test mode user 19311 (separate test clock, send_invoice sub with days_until_due = 60):
Case Result
charge_automatically baseline (AC-004) is_past_due = false, unchanged
First invoice open (AC-001, AC-005) is_past_due = true, status = active, amount_due = 34, currency = USD
Latest invoice paid (AC-003) is_past_due = false
Renewal invoice open (AC-001, AC-005) is_past_due = true, status = active, amount_due = 34, currency = USD
Same as above via cus_ profile (AC-001) same response
Older invoice open, latest paid (AC-002) is_past_due = false

A latest invoice still in draft also returned is_past_due = false (AC-003). void was not part of the E2E.

issues.display_title: Issue #2087: fix(payment): subscription status ignores past_due for users with a cus_ recurring_profile
issues.main_description_html:
Problem Description

GET /v2/payment/subscription/status (app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/GetSubStatus.php) only retrieves the Stripe subscription when user_extra_data.recurring_profile starts with sub (L99). Users whose recurring_profile holds a Stripe customer ID (cus_…) are skipped, so the endpoint always returns the defaults: is_past_due = false, subscription = false, nextPayment = null, status = active, collection_method = charge_automatically.

Because of this, the dashboard dunning gate (useDunningGate) never blocks paid features or shows the dunning modal for these users, even when their Stripe subscription is past_due.

Example

  • User 1001: recurring_profile = cus_LMvBClkhuDwJxr, subscription sub_1KgBMA4UXotNjjkIVXiQiGEy (send_invoice, Pro $34/month).

Expected

When recurring_profile is a cus_… ID, look up the customer's subscription on Stripe and use it to build the status response. recurring_profile stays as it is.

Notes

  • The recurring cron already resolves cus_ profiles to subscriptions (StripeFailedPaymentDetector, RecordStripeRecurringTransactionsHelper).

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: For a cus_… profile, the endpoint finds the customer's subscription and returns the same fields as for a sub_… profile (subscription, nextPayment, status, is_past_due, collection_method, amount_due, currency).
  • AC-002: If the customer has more than one subscription, the endpoint uses the live one (active / past_due / unpaid / trialing), not just the newest.
  • AC-003: If the customer has no live subscription, the response stays the same as today (defaults) and no error is returned.
  • AC-004: user_extra_data.recurring_profile is not modified.
  • AC-005: Unit tests cover a cus_… profile with a past_due subscription, with multiple subscriptions, and with no subscription.

Result

Shipped in PR #2100 (Gitea) (merged into staging 2026-10-29, 3b712777b). All acceptance criteria AC-001 – AC-005 passed.

  • GetSubStatus: for a cus_… profile the endpoint lists the customer's subscriptions on Stripe and uses the newest live one (active / past_due / unpaid / trialing). The response fields are built the same way as for sub_… (shared applyStripeSubscription()).
  • No live subscription, or the customer no longer exists on Stripe → defaults with 200, no error.
  • recurring_profile is only read, never updated.
  • Data check (2026-10-29, live Stripe): 33 users have a cus_ profile. Each customer has exactly one subscription (all statuses counted), all active, so none of them is currently past due.
  • Unit tests (tests/Actions/Payment/GetSubStatusTest.php): cus_ with a past_due subscription, with multiple subscriptions (newest not live), with no subscription, and with a customer missing on Stripe, plus the 2 existing sub_ tests. All 6 pass.
  • E2E on the local API + local DB with Stripe test mode user 19311:
Case Result
cus_, active sub (AC-001, AC-004) same response as the sub_ baseline; recurring_profile unchanged
cus_, past_due sub (AC-001) is_past_due = true, status = past_due, amount_due = 34, currency = USD
cus_ without a subscription (AC-003) 200, defaults
cus_ missing on Stripe 200, defaults (no 409)
cus_ with 2 subs, newest incomplete (AC-002) the older active sub is used

PayPal profiles (RP… / I-…) were not part of the E2E; their code path is unchanged.
